svg.text: v10 — Tree of VSMs: Compressor + Dispatcher
23.2M total · 308K trainable · 131M ternary · d_model=512 · 9 strides · 5 passes
3 passes · shared weights · proven: φ-locking, S3 differentiating
reads: bank_0, bank_1_asc, bank_2_asc → writes: bank_3
2 passes · own weights · kernel-shaped ops · NOT compression
types: INT BOOL FN FN_COMP ERROR
reads: bank_0, bank_1_asc, bank_2_desc, bank_3 → writes: bank_1_desc
x = x − Σ pass_deltas + Σ (meta_gate_i · pass_delta_i)
tokens → embed → L0↑ → L1↑ → L2 → L1↓ → L0↓ → output_norm → logits
Each phase: x = x + gate · tanh(mod_proj(op(x) − x)) — gated additive modulation
6 banks × 3 registers (type, scope, role) × 256 real dims each
S4 reads banks → attends to residual → writes updates to target bank
S3 reads bank state + delta → produces alignment gate (scalar)
Flow: bank_0 → bank_1_asc → bank_2_asc → bank_3 → bank_2_desc → bank_1_desc
Per-phase scalar gate: sigmoid(align(reg_proj, delta_proj) · temp + bias)
Ascending arm: gates differentiate (0.22–0.85) ← working correctly
Descending arm: gates saturate to 1.0 ← everything passes through unchanged
Dispatch → Integrate (adjacent, both local): op + type decided per position
Then StrideStack propagates complete typed dispatch across scales (spatial)
Rationale: typing sees undiluted dispatch signal; stride distributes complete decisions
Ascending S3 learns to stay partially closed ✓
Descending S3 races to 1.0 within first 1K steps ✗
→ Gradient signal forces desc gates open before
